svg.title: Published mind-wandering results from Szpunar, Khan and Schacter, 2013, Experiment 2
svg.desc: Reported mind-wandering means: no interpolated tests 41 percent, restudy 39 percent, interpolated tests 19 percent. These are group means, not a time series or attention-span duration. Uncertainty intervals are not shown.

g.text: PUBLISHED RESULTS · NOT A TIME-SERIES CURVE
A real experiment: retrieval prompts and mind wandering
Self-reported mind wandering (% of thought probes; lower is better)
Szpunar et al. (2013), Experiment 2, n = 48. Reported rounded group means; uncertainty intervals not shown.
